answer_1.quote: We perform human annotations on two prominent summarization datasets: SAMSum and DialogSum... We obtain fine-grained inconsistency annotations for summaries generated (zero-shot) by two prominent LLMs (GPT-4 and Alpaca-13B) across two summarization datasets (SAMSum and DialogSum).

answer_2.quote: We incorporate four metrics into our evaluation framework: two question-answering-based metrics, namely QuestEval and QAFactEval, alongside two natural language inference (NLI) based metrics, SummaC-ZS and SummaC-Conv, which serve as our baseline measures... We also include the established prompt ChatGPT Direct Assessment (ChatGPT-DA) and evaluate its performance across both zero-shot and few-shot scenarios.

answer_3.quote: We introduce two new prompt-based methodologies... identification ... verification ... we call this approach ChatGPT-Span... We introduce a 'mixture of experts' concept... This approach is called ChatGPT-MoE. These methods use GPT-4 (ChatGPT) to identify and verify inconsistent spans in generated summaries.
criteria: error category detection (e.g., Circumstantial Inference, Logical Error, World Knowledge, Referential Error, Figurative Misinterpretation)

answer_4.quote: In the first phase, we enlist two linguist factcheckers from Upwork to assess summary consistency... Inter-annotator agreement, measured using pairwise F-1 metric, results in a substantial agreement of 66.94%... In the second round of annotations, an author of the paper who is an expert linguist meticulously categorized the errors to attain more granularity.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to spot inconsistencies in summaries, marked by spans that lack evidence in the source text or distort information from it, and then categorize each error into defined categories (Logical Error, Circumstantial Inference, World Knowledge, Referential Error, Figurative Misrepresentation, Nonsensical).
criteria: error categorization (Logical Error, Circumstantial Inference, World Knowledge, Referential Error, Figurative Misrepresentation, Nonsensical)
